name: rk
description: 软考系统架构设计师基础知识、专业英语、案例必背卡、案例真题训练和论文训练 Skills。

interface.shortDescription: 软考系统架构设计师基础、英语、案例与论文训练
interface.longDescription: RK Coach 提供八个 Skill：rk-study 编排复习状态和下一步任务，rk-basic 用通俗讲解、计算题步骤和举一反三补基础，rk-english 复习专业英语高频词，rk-case-card 生成案例必背知识卡，rk-case-drill 训练具体案例题、分层提示和变式短练，rk-essay-template 生成可替换论文模板，rk-essay-final 考前按押题主题生成论点卡，rk-essay 诊断和修改论文。
defaultPrompt: Use $rk-study to choose the next review task and carry forward study state
Use $rk-basic to explain this exam topic plainly and give one transfer drill
Use $rk-english to review professional English terms
Use $rk-case-card to review must-memorize case topics
Use $rk-case-drill to review this case answer and create one transfer variant
Use $rk-essay-template to build a paper template
Use $rk-essay-final to generate pre-exam essay topic cards
